=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- README.md:1954; agents.md:2123; changelog.d/review-tier-random-reviewers.md "What this means for operators" paragraph | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: All three documents assert that setting `REVIEW_TIER_RESOLVER_ENABLED=false` always runs the full panel, but the size-tier resolver does not restore the panel when `classify_reviewer_risk_tier` has already reduced it.
  WHY: Dispatch reads `${REVIEWER_ACTIVE_MODELS_FILE}` after both resolvers run; with `REVIEWER_RISK_TIER_ENABLED=1` and `REVIEW_TIER_RESOLVER_ENABLED=0`, the file contains the risk-tier selection (one or two reviewers for a trivial/lite diff, never six). Operators relying on the documentation will believe they have restored the full panel when they have not.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~1575 | PROBLEM: The function unconditionally executes `shift 2`, which aborts under `set -euo pipefail` if a future caller invokes it with fewer than two positional arguments.
  WHY: The current call site always passes at least three (count, seed, model pool), so this is not reachable today; a future isolated or test invocation could instead abort the whole tier classification.

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
